sentence: Great, another unannounced breaking update right before the weekend.
I can't say I'm displeased with how smoothly the migration went.
The setup was an absolute nightmare, but it works like a charm now.
I'd highly recommend this app if you enjoy waiting five minutes for a page to load.
Ever since the patch, my laptop fan sounds like a jet engine taking off.
The app requires 4GB of RAM and Python 3.10 to operate.
